rules.pattern: ^# ((?:观察与猜想|探究与发现|阅读与思考|数学活动|小结|信息技术应用|图说数学史)(?: .+)?)$
^# (?!第[一二三四五六七八九十百千]+章(?: |$)|综合与实践 |目录 )(.+)$

notes: All TOC chapter headings remain H1, sections become H2, subsections become H3.
Non-TOC headings are demoted to H4; assumes original document uses only H1 headings.
Dynamic parent context addition for generic headings (e.g., '探究') is not attempted due to regex limitations.
